ranks.how: Expert Fishing - The Bass and You is sold for 1g by Old Man Heming in Booty Bay, Stranglethorn Vale (/way 27.4 77.0).
At character level 35 and Fishing level 225, Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme can be started by talking to Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh (/way 58.6 60.0).

tips: While you are below level 25 Fishing, you should use Shiny Bauble. Once you hit level 25 Fishing, you won't need to reapply it, as you will already have a 100% catch rate in the starter zones.
At level 75 Fishing, head to a capital city to learn Journeyman Fishing and continue fishing. You will have a 100% catch rate without any lures.

Stranglethorn Vale is generally better for Horde, while Dustwallow Marsh is more accessible for the Alliance. 225+ Fishing is required for a 100% catch rate in these zones, so use lures to reach this level when needed. You can keep fishing in a capital city if you aren't concerned about making money as you level.

changes.text: Many Cooking recipes that use fish have been buffed and added.
Most cooked foods now grant 5% additional experience from kills.
Players with Fishing can craft Fish Bowl, Fishing Rack, or Fishing Hut and place them at Campfires.
Stranglethorn Fishing Tournament: Instead of only the first player completing the quest winning, the first 50 players win.
Stranglethorn Fishing Tournament: The quest will now always reward Arcanite Fishing Pole and Extravagant Extravaganza Coin.

The Extravagant Extravaganza Coin can be exchanged for your choice from the following items: Hook of the Master Angler, Surfer Shoes, Master Angler's Fishing Hat, Empty Fish Bucket, or Bitter Baitling.
Some fish recipes from Classic have been updated in Forever to provide temporary Fishing skill boosts.
Legacy perk Working Overtime (5 ranks): Increases the chance to gain a skill point from primary, secondary, and class tradeskills by 4%.
Legacy perk Luremaster (5 ranks): While using a fishing lure, you have a 25% chance to catch an additional fish.

Legacy perk Dedicated Study (1 ranks): Raises your lowest primary or secondary tradeskill by 1. Once both primary tradeskills and all three secondary tradeskills reach 300, grants 2\u20134 random Elemental Essences instead. 25 sec cast, 23 hr cooldown.
Fishing craft (camp object) Fish Bowl: skill 20, source Trainer
Fishing craft (camp object) Fishing Rack: skill 140, source Drop: Gelihast (Blackfathom Deeps)
Fishing craft (camp object) Fishing Hut: skill 300, source Blueprint: Fishing Hut

quests.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objectives: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

quests.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectives: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

quests.name: You Too Good.
objectives: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).
